title: Russia’s State Duma passes law regulating AI, requiring ‘respect for traditional Russian values’
description: Russia’s lower house of parliament passed legislation governing the development of artificial intelligence in the country. The bill cleared two readings in two days — first reading on July 7, second and third readings on July 8.

title: Chinese companies are ditching Nvidia’s advanced accelerators for domestic AI suppliers
description: Chinese executives said they'll allocate nearly half (46%) of their AI budget to domestic products within the next year.
